project_info.theme: Regional event series for France study 2027 planning
project_info.color_palette: White, Navy Blue, Red, Sky Blue, Fresh Green

main_subject.detail: A campaign poster for the 'Du học Pháp 2027' event series, built around six rounded city photo cards arranged in a grid, each labeled with a future August 2026 event date and Vietnamese city name, topped by a strong outline title and red CTA button.
main_subject.style: Clean roadmap campaign poster with light architectural line art, polished city-photo cards, and strong event-series branding.

items: Top Left: Red script and framed text 'Chuỗi SỰ KIỆN' over large outlined title 'DU HỌC PHÁP 2027'.
Top Right: Red rounded CTA 'ĐĂNG KÝ NGAY' and VFE logo in the upper-right corner.
Bottom Left: City photo cards for Đà Nẵng and Nghệ An.
Bottom Right: Blue dot grid decoration and city photo cards for Hà Nội and Hải Phòng.
Center/Background: Light Eiffel Tower and cathedral line art behind the title, plus six glossy rounded city-photo cards with dates.

lighting_and_atmosphere.effect: Soft neutral white background, crisp card borders, and high visibility for date badges and city names.

Background is a clean white field with faint line art of French landmarks. Surrounding elements: VFE logo, red CTA 'ĐĂNG KÝ NGAY', slogan 'Đúng lộ trình Trúng mục tiêu', and city cards for Đà Nẵng, TP.HCM, Hà Tĩnh, Nghệ An, Hà Nội, and Hải Phòng. Technical style: photo-card event series campaign poster, bright campaign-poster lighting, crisp card readability, 8k resolution, highly detailed.
